answer_4.quote: we asked annotators to directly rewrite LLM-generated answers to make them factually correct
answer_4.guideline: Participants were instructed to revise answers directly in the original text, ensure factual accuracy with respect to the question, use Google or GPT-4o for fact-checking without copying, and preserve the original structure and style.
